profile.headline: Web Developer | Photographer | Marketing Specialist
profile.summary: Haley specializes in graphic design, web design, and photography. You can visit her website at haleycward.com.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
-Design pages, marketing materials, and ads with Adobe InDesign and Illustrator
-Create and concept covers in Adobe Photoshop
-Oversee the design marketing of the Indy Food Weeks including social media images, print ads, and internal marketing documents
-Oversee the design of NUVO.net using BLOX Total CMS
-Design and update the Indy Food Week websites and the NUVO Media Kit 
using WordPress and HTML/CSS 
-Assist in the design of five weekly newsletters using MailChimp and HTML/CSS

positions.title: Photojournalist
positions.description:
Photograph stories for print and web
Edit photographs in Adobe Photoshop and caption using AP Style
Upload photos and stories with Blox Total CMS

positions.title: Art Director, Photo Editor
positions.description:
-Photograph covers, features and portraits
-Organize photographers for stories
-Edit photographs for print
-Post photos to the web

positions.title: Design Intern
positions.description:
-Design print products including brochures, posters, and booklets for clients in Adobe Illustrator and InDesign
-Work with developers and content specialists to design websites with Indiana University’s long-form story platform 
-Assist developers and designers with creating pages and additional artwork 
for University web pages with IU’s backend editor

positions.title: Photographer, Football & Men's Basketball Beat Photographer
positions.description:
-Photograph news events, sporting events and features stories
-Edit photos in Adobe Bridge and Photoshop
-Write captions in AP Style

positions.title: Photo Editor
positions.description:
-Organizing events and photographers
-Select photos for publishing in the newspaper 
-Edit photos in Adobe Bridge and captions for AP style
-Shoot and edit video

positions.title: Photo Intern at HGTV Magazine
positions.description:
-Assist the Photo Editor and Photo Director on shoots
-Find stock images for print
-Search and buy products for shoots

positions.title: Art and Photo Director
positions.description:
-Design the magazine using Adobe InDesgin and Adobe Illustrator
-Shoot portraits and features
-Assist staff members on how to shoot photographs for their stories
-Create a design style guide for future designers

positions.title: Photo Intern
positions.description:
-Photograph news, sports and features stories
-Edit photographs in Photo Mechanic and curves using Adobe Photoshop
-Shoot and edit video in Final Cut Pro 7
-Post photos and galleries to the web

positions.title: Photo Intern
positions.description:
-Photographing assignments
-Assisting on photo shoots
-Writing for the website

positions.title: Graphic Design Intern
positions.description:
-Create new and update flyers and brochures in Adobe Illustrator on InDesign
-Take and look for photos for flyers
-Mount graphics and cut rack cards
-Research ideas for upcoming projects
--Catalog images

positions.title: Photographer and Writer
positions.description:
-Report and photograph speakers, events, and meetings
-Write captions and edit photos on Adobe Bridge

honors.title: Runner-up College Photographer of the Year
honors.issuer: Issued by Indiana News Photographers Association · Feb 2016
